children: The NBFC’s consolidated net profit rose to Rs 375 crore in the September quarter, while total income increased 70.2 per cent year-on-year to Rs 2,625 crore

Poonawalla Fincorp shares surged as much as 8 per cent in early trade on Monday after the non-banking financial company reported a nearly fivefold increase in consolidated net profit for the September quarter.

The stock climbed to an intraday high of Rs 484 on the NSE before paring some gains. The rally followed a sharp increase in earnings, supported by higher interest income and growth in the company’s lending business.

Poonawalla Fincorp’s consolidated profit after tax rose to Rs 374.85 crore in the second quarter of FY27, from Rs 74 crore in the corresponding quarter a year earlier, according to the company’s financial results. This represented growth of about 406 per cent year-on-year.

Total income increased 70.2 per cent to Rs 2,624.50 crore from Rs 1,542.89 crore in the year-ago period. Interest income rose to Rs 2,416 crore from Rs 1,402 crore, reflecting an expansion in income generated from lending operations. The company’s assets under management (AUM) stood at Rs 74,008 crore as of 30 September 2026, indicating the scale of its lending portfolio at the end of the quarter.
Net Interest Income And Asset Quality

Net interest income (NII), including fees and other income as reported by the company, rose to Rs 1,380 crore in Q2FY27 from Rs 764 crore in the corresponding quarter last year, according to the company’s exchange filing. The increase reflects higher income from lending after accounting for the relevant funding costs. The company also reported an improvement in asset quality. Gross non-performing assets declined by 17 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 39 basis points year-on-year.

The stock opened about 6 per cent higher at Rs 476.90 on the NSE and touched an intraday high of Rs 484. It subsequently pared its gains and was trading at Rs 461.75, up 3.1 per cent, around 10 am on Monday. More than 15 million shares changed hands on the NSE in the first 45 minutes of trading, with transactions valued at Rs 716.46 crore, making the stock one of the exchange’s most actively traded counters by value.
